releases.name: The Legend of Fancy Realm Remake
Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
releases.summary:
Touhou Koumakyou - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil, with music and graphics remastered by an older and wiser creator (self-described).

Touhou Koumakyou - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil is a vertical-scrolling 2D shoot-'em-up where you weave through dazzling curtains of bullets.

Take control of the shrine maiden Reimu or the magician Marisa, and set out to resolve the incident threatening Gensokyou. Dodge and slip your way forward through barrages of bullets dense enough to fill the entire screen.

releases.name: Code Vein II: Mask of Idris
releases.summary:
In Mask of Idris, players are transported into a new, history-altering storyline where multiple timelines and worlds collide.

Forged from countless collapsed timelines, the Forsaken World is unlike anything players have seen before.

At its core lies a massive, swirling convergence of emotions, continuously pulling in fragments from across time and space. This phenomenon is no longer contained and now threatens to spill into the real world.

Exploration in this environment involves both danger and discovery, as players uncover the remnants of forgotten histories.

With new environments, characters, and a deeply immersive storyline, Mask of Idris expands the CODE VEIN II experience beyond its original boundaries.

Players will explore uncharted territories, confront powerful enemies, and unravel a narrative shaped by the collapse of multiple worlds.

releases.name: Alembic
releases.summary: A falling-sand sandbox built on the **real periodic table**. Every element has genuine physical properties, and reactions emerge from real chemistry — rust iron, ignite thermite, run a galvanic cell, split a uranium pile to criticality. Discover it all in an encyclopedia that fills as you play.

releases.name: Black Friday Janitor: Clean the Whole Mall
releases.summary: Black Friday Janitor is a organization game that hands you the biggest clean-up job of the year. Thousands of items: misplaced products to return to their correct spots, rubbish to collect and dirt to clean up. Don't expect to finish it all in one go!

releases.name: Murdercartel
releases.summary: Embark on an online 2D fantasy MMORPG featuring open-world exploration, challenging dungeons, epic boss battles, gathering, crafting, trading, professions, rare loot, player-driven progression and a persistent multiplayer world full of adventure.

releases.name: KN Tower - Build your skyscraper empire
releases.summary: Build, expand and manage your own skyscraper in this deep building and management simulation. Design every floor, optimize elevators, manage tenants, businesses and finances. Create a vibrant vertical metropolis.

releases.name: SPACE JK
releases.summary: A laid-back idle life sim where you watch over cute pixel-art roommates called JK. Collect furniture, decorate the room, and build your own sticker book from the stickers they draw for you every day. Trade with other players for the ones you're missing. Decorate, collect, and again tomorrow.

releases.name: ArmedAbyss
releases.summary: A Candy Letters Crush is the best way to teach your kids the alphabet.With amazing images and sounds, the game uses the candies theme to help your kid to learn the letters associating.Download now!

releases.name: ARETIAS: Cursed Island
releases.summary: This app creates and tracks dice rolls for your favorite dice-based games.  Watch your roll distribution build as you roll the dice.  Dice Tracker does all the work for you, and with the in-app purchase, you can roll additional modes of dice to spice up your games!A must-have for all ages of board gamers, this app is great for your Settlers of Catan get-together, or for keeping tabs on your next game of Monopoly.  Also a great educational experience to learn about dice statistics!Free Features:• Dice roll generator (for 2 dice)• Dice tracking interface for rolling real dice• Interactive, animated, roll distribution chart• Roll distribution chart offers information on ? from expected, number of rolls, and rolls since that number last came up.• Shake to Undo• Player indicator to help you keep track of who's roll it is• This app has a clean, clutter-free UI and is visually engagingIn-App Purchase Available - Additional Dice DistributionsPlay your favorite games with distributions that differ from the way real dice behave!• Inverted Distribution - Roll more 12's and 2's than what a real dice can offer, and fewer 7's.• Stacked Distribution - Reduce chance, guarantee that you'll see each of the 36 possible dice rolls after every 36 rolls.• Stack-6 - Similar to "Stacked Distribution" but 6 rolls are discarded.  Result is similar to a standard dice distribution with a small amount of chance added.• Flat Distribution - Even the odds.  Get equal odds of each available roll total.Get all of these modes for 1 purchase!

releases.name: Super Takoyaki Battle
releases.summary: Experience takoyaki-making like never before! Make as many as you can in an all-out battle!
